ModMetaData.description:
[h1]RimSynapse - Chat[/h1] [b]📚 [url=https://github.com/RimSynapse/RimSynapse-Chat/wiki]Official Wiki & Documentation[/url][/b]
[b]Companion Mod for RimSynapse.[/b] Allows colonists to converse dynamically using LLMs.
[h2]Compatibility Matrix[/h2] [list] [*] [b]Royalty DLC:[/b] Compatible & Optional. Enables noble tone demands and psycast interjections. [*] [b]Ideology DLC:[/b] Compatible & Optional. Enables faith debates and active proselytizing. [*] [b]Biotech DLC:[/b] Compatible & Optional. Enables xenotype dialects and mechanitor comms. [*] [b]Anomaly DLC:[/b] Compatible & Optional. Enables paranoid void whispers. [/list]
